_comment: Story 13.4: every word of 'The Guild Falls' screen (scenes/game_over_screen.gd). DRAFT text (Raphael rewrites). reasons: one line per cause, the key the guild fell with (GameBus.game_over_triggered): bankruptcy (the tax's grace ran out), soft_lock (no one alive, no coin, no one to hire); no_survivors is for Story 21.3; abandoned_tavern for an old check nothing calls; a cause with no line takes fallback. stats: the labels of the run's three numbers (GameManager.run_summary). buttons, confirm: the two buttons and the question each asks first.
title: The Guild Falls

reasons.bankruptcy: The tax went unpaid. At dawn the collectors came and took the keys.
reasons.soft_lock: No one left to send, and no coin to hire. The doors stayed shut, and the town forgot the guild.
reasons.no_survivors: No one came back. There was no one left to carry the name.
reasons.abandoned_tavern: No one came in, and nothing went out. The tavern closed its doors for good.
reasons.fallback: The guild could not go on.

confirm.new_run: Start a new guild? This one is gone.
confirm.main_menu: Leave for the main menu? This guild is gone.
